content: Xoossa sunththinne iza timirtey cayettontta mala aylleteththa qambara giddon dizayti wuri ba godaas kumeththa bonchchoy bessizayssa eretto.

Ammaniza godati diza ammaniza ashkarati godati isttas ishata gidida gishshas godatas bessiza bonchcho immetto; harappeka istta ooson maadettiza ammaniza godati isttas dosettidayta gidida gishshas nekka haytantta mala yo7ota tamaarsanaassinne zoranaas bessees.
Wordo Timirtenne Tumu Dureteth
Oonikka wordo timirte tamaarsiko Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa lo7o qaalanne Ayana tumateththaa minththiza timirtera gaaggonttayssa gidikko,

hessaadey otoreteththan kumidessinne aykkoka yuushshi qoppenna; issi issi qaalata gishshas palamettanaassinne ooyetanaas iita amoy izan dees; heytikka qanaateteth, oosh, cash, iita sidhe kaaleththeettes.
Tumay isttafe eketti gidiin Ayana ooson wodhe demmana misatiza asatanne qofa pace asata giddon gooshettidi duuxxontta oosh eheettes.
Gido attiin Tumu Ayana as gideththi nuus dizayssan woppu giidi duussara gita wodhe.
Gaasoykka nu hayssa ha alameza yishe aykkoka ekki yibeekko; bishekka qasse aykkoka ekki bookko.
Gido attiin nuus maanayssinne nu may7anayssi diikko gidana.
Dure gidanaas koyzayti gidikko gede paaceninne narxan gelidi oykettizayssa mala daro hadaninne iita amon un7etteettes.
Gaasoykka miishsha siiqoy iitateth ubbaas xapho; issi issi asati dure gidana giidi amottida amoppe dendidayssan ammano ogeppe balettidi haraso bidanne barkka bana daro meto giddo gelththida.
Phawuloosi Ximtoosas Immida Hadara Qaala
Nenoo Xoossa asoo! Ne hessa ubbaafe baqata; xilloteth, Tumu Ayanan duus, ammano, siiqo, dandayanne ashketeth kaalla.
Ammano baaxe lo7eththa baaxeta; daro markkatta sinththan lo7o ammaneteththan ne markkattidayssanne ne izas xeygettida mernaa de7oza lo7eththa oykka.
Ubbaasikka de7o immiza Xoossaa achchan hessaththoka Phanxoosa Philaxoosa sinththan tumaa markkattida Yesus Kirstoosa sinththan ta nena hadara gizay,
Godaa Yesus Kirstoosi qonccana gakkanaas nees imettida oosoza wosoy baynda ne polana mala bessees.
He qoncceththi anjjettidayssi barkka ubbaa haarizayssinne kawota kawoy, godatas Goday izi ba woden bessana.
Izi xalla hayqqonttayssa; oonikka shiiqanaas dandayontta poo7o giddon dees; iza be7ida asi oonikka baa; beyana dandayzaadeyka deenna; izas wolqqaynne bonchchoy mernaappe mernaas gido. Amiin.
Hayssa ha alamezan duretidayti otorettontta mala azaza; nu ufayettana mala wursika darssi tirfisidi nuus immiza Xoossaan attiin ammanththontta miishshaan ammanettontta mala asaas yoota.
Lo7o ooththana malanne lo7o ooson dureta gidana mala, kiyatanne shaakki immanaas dosizayta gidana mala asaa azaza.
Hessaththoka tumu gidida de7o demmana mala buroppe yaana wodes asay mino xapho gidiza haaro baas shiishshana.
Ximtoosaa! Ne hadara ekkidayssa wursa naaga; Xoossaa bonchchisontta hada doona lom7ulom7afenne wordo erateth geetettiza asi baappe medhdhi kessida timirtefe haakka.
Nuus hessa mala erateththi dees giza issi issi asati hessaththo ooson ammano ogeppe balettida; Xoossa kiyateththi inttenara gido.
